text.tspan: Covers US 2.0.2. /admin/sites exists but has no Add Site flow. All add steps are Proposed.
ProtectedRoute requireAdmin hides the page in the browser only. It reads user_metadata, so it is not a security check.
[A Site with the same name exists (AT2)]
[Caller is not an Admin, for example a Steward
A new Site is active by default (US 2.0.3 AT5). getSitesOnline reads active Sites, so the new Site
shows in Site search (AT5). Open question: can the Admin save after the duplicate warning?
namesite is UNIQUE in the local schema copy (webapp/supabase/migrations).
Open question: load the KML into a table or read the file each time. W26_kml_sites is the proposed option (see US 6.0.1).

svg.text: Check session and Admin role on server (Proposed)
Select a boundary (AT1), enter name and county
Read W26_sites-pa rows with the same name,
Show a possible-duplicate warning before save
Check required fields, for example name
Block creation and highlight the empty fields
Check session and Admin role on server
Show "Only an Admin can add a Site"
Insert W26_sites-pa row (is_active = true) with the boundary.
If it is a suggestion, also set source_feature_id
Show the error and keep the form
Show the new Site in the list
